name: Drakaniia/skills
description: Codebase health agent skills — audit structure, execute refactoring, prevent decay, and enforce clean code design.

audit-codebase.name: audit-codebase
audit-codebase.description: Scan any codebase and flag structural health issues — folder bloat, oversized files, deep nesting, naming inconsistencies, orphaned files, doc sprawl, and empty directories.

folder-architecture.name: folder-architecture
folder-architecture.description: Enforce best-practice folder organization before every file creation or modification — prevents structural decay at the point of change.

code-design.name: code-design
code-design.description: Enforce function-level design principles — pure functions, single responsibility, guard clauses, side-effect management, and top-to-bottom readability.

implement-folder-architecture.name: implement-folder-architecture
implement-folder-architecture.description: Execute a folder architecture refactor from an audit report — moves files, splits directories, refactors imports, and verifies builds incrementally.
